title: FalsegreenFinding
description: A single finding produced by the falsegreen-skill J1-J6 analysis.

case.description: Case from the skill catalog: a semantic case number (e.g., 18), a structural code (C2, C2b, C11a, CC), a JS/TS code (JS21), a Robot code (R3), a diagnostic/coupling code (D1, M2), or an AI-only semantic code (S1).

judgment.description: The J1-J6 judgment category assigned to this finding.

language.description: Programming language or test stack of the test under analysis.

level.description: Test pyramid level inferred in Step 1: unit, integration (API or database), or e2e. `fixture` marks a finding in a file that is data, a shared resource, an example, or a perf fixture rather than a behavioral suite. The level changes what counts as a valid oracle.

intent.description: Test intent classification from Step 3. `scaffold` marks an unimplemented placeholder (empty stub, TODO-only body, generated skeleton) where the finding is about the missing implementation, not a wrong oracle.

test.description: Identity of the test function or method where the finding was detected.

name.description: Name of the test function or method.

line_start.description: First line of the test function (1-indexed).

line_end.description: Last line of the test function (1-indexed).

finding.description: One sentence describing what is wrong with the test.

evidence.description: The specific lines from the source file that triggered this finding.

oracle.description: Citation of the independent oracle (spec, docstring, API contract) used to establish the correct expected value. Required only when case is the semantic case 18, not structural code C18.

fix_hint.description: One sentence suggestion for how to fix the identified issue.
